'''Beldemaine''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is plump with silver bells in her hair.

==Strength Abilities==
Beldemaine is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|31}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

As she is Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability with Healing for an Aes Sedai.

==History==
She is from Arafel.

==Activities==
She has sided with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]]. 

She is present in the [[Little Tower]] when Nynaeve Heals both [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Leane Sharif]] of [[stilling]] completely shocking everyone.
